faq.q0: How much can I earn per month with MoveSpot?
faq.a0: The guaranteed minimum is €17.50 per vehicle per active day (= 70% of the advertiser floor rate of €25). With 15 active days per month, that is at least €262 in net supplementary income. In dense areas (Paris, Lyon, Marseille), campaigns are more expensive and revenues can reach €49/day for a taxi.
faq.q1: Which vehicles are accepted on MoveSpot?
faq.a1: Food trucks, utility vans, taxis, rideshare cars, delivery scooters, personal cars and company fleets. The vehicle must be roadworthy and have a usable glass or body surface for display. Validation includes 4 photos.
faq.q2: Is it compatible with my taxi or rideshare activity?
faq.a2: Yes. MoveSpot is designed as 100% passive supplementary income: you drive as usual, GPS tracking validates the kilometres driven in the campaign zone. No additional route constraints.
faq.q3: How and when am I paid?
faq.a3: Your earnings accumulate in your MoveSpot wallet as active campaigns run. You can request a bank transfer from a balance of €50. Transfers are processed within 3 to 5 business days.
faq.q4: Can I refuse an advertising campaign?
faq.a4: Yes. Each campaign request is submitted to you with the details (brand, visual, zone, duration). You accept or refuse freely, with no justification required. You keep control of what you carry.
faq.a5: Registration is completely free. MoveSpot takes a 30% commission on each campaign, only when you generate income. No fixed fees, no subscription for owners.
faq.q6: How long does vehicle validation take?
faq.a6: Validation generally takes 48 business hours after submitting your profile and the 4 photos of your vehicle. Once validated, you appear on the marketplace and can receive proposals from advertisers.
